prompt_text: I need new tires installed in Pleasanton. Which specific tire shops should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
answer_verbatim:
Quick question before I make specific recommendations: which Pleasanton do you mean (Pleasanton, CA is common), and what vehicle (make/model/year) or tire size and budget/type (all‑season, summer, winter, run‑flat)? Do you need same‑day install or mobile service?

While you reply, here are the best places to call and why each is worth contacting (these apply to most U.S. Pleasantons):

- Discount Tire / America’s Tire
  - Why call: very large tire selection across price points, frequent inventory of popular sizes, competitive pricing, fast same‑day installs at many locations, price-match policies.
- Les Schwab Tire Center
  - Why call: good customer service reputation, often includes perks like free rotations/flat repairs depending on location, knowledgeable staff for local driving conditions, helpful for light trucks/SUVs.
- Firestone Complete Auto Care
  - Why call: national warranty programs, can bundle services (install + balance + alignment), and they handle related repairs if needed.
- Pep Boys / Mavis Tire (depending on local availability)
  - Why call: combined tire and general auto service — useful if you anticipate needing brakes, alignment, or other work at the same time.
- A nearby independent/local tire shop (search Yelp/Google for “Pleasanton tire shop” and sort by ratings)
  - Why call: independents often beat chains on personalized service, negotiating on price, and local knowledge of what tire models hold up best in the area.
- Mobile tire/roadside services (e.g., on‑demand mobile tire fitters)
  - Why call: convenient if you can’t or prefer not to drive, some services will mount and balance at your home/office.

What I can do next:
- If you confirm Pleasanton, CA and give vehicle/tire size/budget and whether you need same‑day or mobile service, I’ll pull together 4–6 specific shops in that city (names, phone numbers, what they’re best for, and what to ask when you call).
- Or I can show the exact questions to ask the shops now (price for tires, mount & balance, alignment, disposal fee, warranty, estimated wait time). Which do you prefer?
